changelog: v1.3.8.5: Resolved details page Exclude & Remove play button reappearance and view hang with permanent DOM button removal and native back navigation. Eliminated context menu injection lag (0ms synchronous render for details and cached items). Fixed scraper missing releases (e.g. Aasha) by adding release year to TMDB/OMDb queries and subforum language trust fallback. Preserved natural chronological release ordering in Recently Added by staggering task timestamps based on forum page priority.
description: Native Downloads ecosystem for Jellyfin. Scrapes external forums for new media and integrates with Seedr and Torbox for downloading.
name: JellyFetch
overview: External media scraper and download manager. Integrates Seedr and Torbox.
